text.aria-label: Title text 'Figure 7c: Measured output of the six solar farms and the XGBoost model's out-of-fold forecast over one week'
text.tspan: Figure 7c: Measured output of the six solar farms and the XGBoost
model's out-of-fold forecast over one week

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Hourly output as a percentage of capacity, measured and as forecast out of fold by the XGBoost model given ENS's mean and UKV-CEDA at lead day 1, averaged over its fitting seeds. The XGBoost model uses the primary setting. A gap in a line is an hour outside the scored rows. The week is chosen by rule from measured output alone, within one era: the week whose daily mean output varies most from day to day. Each vertical axis runs from 0 to 110% of the generator's own capacity.'
text.tspan: Hourly output as a percentage of capacity, measured and as forecast out of fold by the XGBoost model given ENS's
mean and UKV-CEDA at lead day 1, averaged over its fitting seeds. The XGBoost model uses the primary setting. A gap
in a line is an hour outside the scored rows.
The week is chosen by rule from measured output alone, within one era: the week whose daily mean output varies most
from day to day. Each vertical axis runs from 0 to 110% of the generator's own capacity.
